name: Can I replace just one window, or do I need to do them all?

mainEntity.name: Can I replace just one window, or do I need to do them all?

acceptedAnswer.text: You absolutely can replace just one window if it's damaged or if you're looking to upgrade a specific area of your home. There's no requirement to replace all windows simultaneously. However, replacing multiple windows at once can sometimes be more cost-effective due to economies of scale in labor and materials. We can assess your specific situation and help you decide whether a single window replacement or a larger project is the best option for your needs and budget.
acceptedAnswer.description: You can replace just one window, though replacing multiple simultaneously might be more cost-effective. We can help you decide the best approach.
